customers_say: Customers find the smart lock easy to install and use, with a premium appearance and strong security features. Moreover, they appreciate the variety of unlocking methods, including fingerprint, PIN, remote OTP, NFC card, and manual deadbolt. However, the connectivity receives mixed feedback - while it connects via Bluetooth, some customers note it doesn't support Wi-Fi gateway. Additionally, opinions on value for money are divided, with some finding it worth the cost while others advise against purchasing it.

reviews.title: Good Lock
reviews.body: Service - I’ve ordered this product on Wednesday after a day I’ve received. Same day I received call from installation team. Ramesh Installed the lock next day which was very quick. 10/10 on service. Product - Product is 8/10 lacks function like Wi-fi. Batteries aren’t provided so you’ve to get it from outside. Fingerprint recognition is good feature along with nfc card. Appearance wise also it looks good. Ease of use any can set it up it’s that easy.
